model.description: A compact Grounding DINO open-vocabulary detector that runs in the browser and locates objects described by user-provided text labels, returning confidence scores and pixel-coordinate bounding boxes.
intendedUses: Prototype prompt-conditioned object detection for images.
Locate uncommon object categories that are not present in a fixed detector label list.
Build browser image annotation, search, and accessibility experiments.
limitations: Detection quality depends strongly on label wording; short lowercase noun phrases usually work better than abstract or ambiguous prompts.
Small, occluded, blurred, unusual, or densely packed objects may be missed or assigned inaccurate boxes.
Scores are not calibrated probabilities, and different label sets can change the returned detections.
The model may reflect biases in its training data and must not be used alone for surveillance, identity, safety-critical, or other high-impact decisions.

benchmark.qualityGate: For prompts 'a person' and 'a dog', output must contain a finite 'a person' detection with score >= 0.3 and IoU >= 0.4 against the checked-in subject box, return no 'a dog' false positive above threshold, and contain only valid boxes.
